description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing 'Dish' entities within a project, including actions for viewing, editing, creating, deleting, and repositioning dishes and their ingredients.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Dish
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing dish-related actions within the Coocook project.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Sets up the dish object in the stash based on the provided ID, used as a chained base for other actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the edit page for a specific dish, including ingredients, recipes, and related data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a dish and redirects to the project edit page.

methods.name: delete_ajax
methods.description: Deletes a dish via AJAX and returns a success JSON response.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new dish related to a meal, based on submitted data.

methods.name: from_recipe
methods.description: Creates a dish from a recipe, based on submitted data.

methods.name: recalculate
methods.description: Recalculates dish ingredients based on servings.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an ingredient to a dish.

methods.name: update_ajax
methods.description: Updates dish details via AJAX and returns the updated data.

methods.name: reposition
methods.description: Repositions an ingredient within a dish (move up or down).

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the edit page for a dish.
